name: combat_cell_free
proto: int combat_cell_free(int mover_tile, int x, int y)
purpose: Returns 1 when combat cell (y,x) may be entered by a combatant drawn with mover_tile (Ghidra params: param_1=y, param_2=x, param_3=mover_tile). Cells outside 0..10 return 1 (the caller treats leaving the map separately). Inside: the map tile (get_map_tile) must pass can_enter_tile and not be 0xff; then every monster-table slot at that cell is checked (tile 0xeb always blocks; 0xe8..0xeb fields, 0x1e, 0x1f and 0 never block; any other object blocks when its anim tile (+1) is non-zero) and every roster entry at that cell with flags not containing 0x24 and non-zero blocks. The a2b6 'function' is the body of this one (Ghidra split it because SHOPPES vector 07ee lands there).

0xba14.name: g_combat_roster
0xba14.meaning: combat roster: +0 monster HP, +1 initiative, +2 flags (0x80 party, 0x40 monster, 0x20 out, 0x10 (room) immobile, 0x08 asleep, 0x04 swallowed, 0x02 fleeing/may leave, 0x01 charmed/chaos), +3 member or monster type, +4 monster-table slot, +5 turn counter, +6 x, +7 y

0x5c5a.name: g_monster_table
0x5c5a.meaning: monster/object table: +0 tile, +1 anim tile, +2 x, +3 y, +4 z, +5 value1, +6 anim state, +7 target

notes: vectors 1778:02f6/057e/07b2; used by SJOG move_combatant, CMDS, CAST, COMSUBS

name: fn_1000_a2b6_fragment
purpose: Not a function: the loop body of combat_cell_free (a290) reached by JGE from a2ae. SHOPPES vector 1778:07ee targets the same address in SHOPPES.OVL, which is why Ghidra named it SHOPPES_a2b6.

name: monster_ranged_attack
proto: int monster_ranged_attack(int attacker, int target, int skip_hit_roll)
purpose: Ranged attack by roster entry attacker on target (Ghidra: param_1=skip_hit_roll, param_2=target, param_3=attacker). Fires only if the attacker type is 0x1a or rand(0..255) < 0x80, and not when the type has monster flag 0x8000 while g_status_icon is 'N' or 0x1c. Plays the attack sweep (0x96,5,400,0x2ee), computes hit = attack_hits(0, -g_spell_mode, attacker, target) (0 when skip_hit_roll != 0), then COMSUBS ea02(missile tile 0x15cc[type], hit, target y, target x, attacker) animates the missile and returns the roster entry actually struck (-1 none); that entry is flashed, newline, deal_attack_damage(attacker, hit) and COMSUBS e4f2(attacker, hit). Returns 1 if the attack was attempted else 0.

0x15cc.name: g_monster_missile_tile
0x15cc.meaning: projectile tile per creature type used by ranged attacks

0x153c.name: g_monster_flags
0x153c.meaning: creature ability flags (0x8000 magic attack absorbed by 'N' protection)

0x588f.name: g_spell_mode
0x588f.meaning: save 0x2E9: 1 while the current attack is a spell (set by Cast, cleared each turn)

notes: only called via the a670 tail of a4b6 with skip_hit_roll=0

name: monster_choose_and_attack
purpose: Monster attack step for roster entry ri. find_nearest_enemy picks the target (none -> return 0). Charmed entry (flag 1): if adjacent (COMSUBS e6b4(target,ri) == 1) sets g_attack_weapon = 0x21 and runs COMSUBS edd8(0x21, target, ri), returns 1. Otherwise: a wasted rand(0..255) when the target is a party member wearing amulet '-' and the type has flag 0x8000; the attack requires distance <= 0x159c[type] (range). Type 0x1a sets its monster anim state 0x20. Adjacent: type 0x2d also sets anim state 0x20, attack sweep, g_monster_interference[target] = ri, attack_hits(0,-g_spell_mode,ri,target): miss -> 1; hit by a thief type (flag bit 1) with rand(0..3)!=0 and food>0 -> '\nA <name> stole some food!', food -= 5, tone, status window, 1; else flash target, newline, deal_attack_damage(ri,target), COMSUBS e4f2(ri,target), 1. Within range but not adjacent: monster_ranged_attack(0,target,ri). The a5f6 and a670 Ghidra functions are tails of this one.

0x58a8.name: g_monster_interference
0x58a8.meaning: per roster entry: index of the entry attacking it this turn, 0xff none

0x589d.name: g_attack_weapon
0x589d.meaning: item id of the weapon/spell used by the current attack (0x21 charmed attack)

name: fn_1000_a5f6_fragment
purpose: Not a function: the melee-hit tail of a4b6 (food theft or damage) reached by JNZ from a5ed; LOOKOBJ vector 1778:079a lands here in LOOKOBJ.OVL.

name: fn_1000_a670_fragment
purpose: Not a function: tail of a4b6 that calls monster_ranged_attack(0, target, ri) with a4b6's locals and falls into its epilogue (RET 2).

name: monster_turn
purpose: AI turn for g_active_combatant. g_attack_weapon = 0. Skipped while g_status_icon is 'T' (time stop), on a coin flip while 'Q' (quickness), or when the entry is swallowed (flag 4). Asleep (flag 8): wakes on rand(0..16)==16. Else: type '-' (0x2d) resets its monster anim state to 0; not fleeing (flag 2 clear): COMSUBS e2d4 (special action; non-zero ends the turn) then monster_choose_and_attack (non-zero ends the turn); fleeing: a monster regains 1 HP on rand(0..3)==3 and monster_morale re-evaluates the flee flag. Then monster_move: returned 0 -> a fleeing entry attacks instead; moved -> if g_combat_state_flags & 0x10 (stepped off the map) prints newline, tone, '<name> escapes!' and remove_combatant(-1 - index) (type '/' 0x2f monsters also run chaos_sword_passout), then refresh_map_view.

0x58a2.name: g_combat_state_flags
0x58a2.meaning: per-turn result flags: 0x10 combatant left the map, 0x20 attack absorbed/zero, 8 poisoned, 2 vanished

name: run_party_only_command
purpose: Prints the command name msg (Ghidra: param_1=kind, param_2=msg). If the active combatant is not a party member (player-controlled charmed monster) prints "Can't!" (0x6d98) and returns 1 (re-prompt). Else runs kind: 0 SJOG cmd_get, 1 SJOG cmd_jimmy, 2 SJOG cmd_open, 3 ZSTATS f476 (Ready), 4 SJOG cmd_search, 5 CAST d712 (Use item); returns 0 (turn consumed).

name: append_equipped_item_name
purpose: strcat helper for the combat prompt (Ghidra: param_1=need_separator, param_2=item). Returns 0 without output when item == 0xff or g_item_attack[item] == 0 (not a weapon). Otherwise appends ', ' (0x6da0) when need_separator != 0, then the item's long name g_name_ptrs[item] (0x17f6), to g_ool_buffer (0xb21e, reused as the prompt buffer) and returns 1. The inline strlen/memcpy loops are MSC strcat.

0xb21e.name: g_ool_buffer
0xb21e.meaning: scratch string buffer for the combat prompt

name: party_member_turn
purpose: Player-controlled turn for g_active_combatant. Sets g_party_x/y to the entry position. If g_active_member != 0xff and this entry is not that member only combat_turn_effects runs. A party member with '#' (Chaos sword, 0x23) in left or right hand (record +0x1b/+0x1c) gets roster flag 1, g_active_member = 0xff, status dirty and is run by monster_turn. Otherwise highlight the status line, redraw if dirty, build '\n<name>, armed with <helm,left,right | bare hands>' + 0x6dbe in g_ool_buffer and print it; command loop: swallowed (flag 4) 'ARGH!' + noise + regurgitate_check ends the turn; asleep (flag 8) wakes on rand<0x10, prints 0x6dc8, ends turn; else read_command_key: 1..4 move_combatant (0 = re-read); Ctrl-S sound toggle (re-read); Esc CMDS combat_escape_all (result = re-prompt); space 'Pass'; '0' clears active player; '1'..'6' set_active_player (failure re-prompts); 'A' COMSUBS ef76(weapon count, entry); 'C' Cast: COMSUBS ebdc selects a spell, 0 -> g_attack_is_spell=g_spell_mode=1 then 'Absorbed!' + sweep noise when g_status_icon=='N' or (no crown and location backup 0x12 Castle Blackthorn) else CAST cd3a; 'G'/'J'/'O'/'R'/'S'/'U' run_party_only_command 0/1/2/3/4/5; 'K' combat_klimb (0 = re-read); 'P' CMDS cmd_push; 'Y' CMDS cmd_yell; 'Z' ZSTATS ec1a; 'T' print_refusal(3,'Talk'); 'B','X' print_refusal(1); 'E','F','H','I','L','M','N','Q','V' print_refusal(2); 'D','W' print name and re-prompt; 0xfc toggles g_flush_after_key; other keys print 0x6ee6 and re-read. Re-prompt rebuilds the prompt line. Afterwards the highlight is XOR-ed off and, unless the key was '0'..'6', combat_turn_effects, refresh_map_view and combat_check_absorbed run.

0x5890.name: g_attack_is_spell
0x5890.meaning: save 0x2EA: 1 while a cast spell is the current attack (halves no undead damage, sleep/poison spells)

notes: local key byte is uninitialised in the original on the Chaos-sword path (Rust uses 0, so the turn effects run); play_sweep_noise is called with junk string-address arguments (0x6d60, 0x2648) exactly as in the binary

name: combat_main_loop
purpose: The combat main loop (vector 1778:04b2; ROOT run_encounter and DUNGEON room entry call it). g_combat_exit = 0, refresh_map_view, draw_status_window, flush_keyboard, count_combatants_by_side (g_dy = party-side count, g_dx = enemy count), g_no_more_enemies = (g_dx == 0). Then forever over roster entries 0..31 (g_active_combatant): g_door_tile = 0; skip entries without 0x80/0x40 or with 0x20. A party member whose status is 'D' is flagged 0x20, flashed and apply_damage(99) removes it. Entries standing on a combat-map tile with (tile & 0xfe) == 0x84 are skipped. Otherwise the turn counter (+5) decrements; at 0 it is reset to 36 - initiative and the entry acts: crosshair hidden, g_combat_state_flags/g_spell_mode/g_attack_is_spell/g_attack_weapon cleared, g_turn_tick (0x5882) incremented and at 10 reset with pass_time(1); g_focus_blink = 1; party side -> party_member_turn else monster_turn; then g_monster_interference[entry] = 0xff, apply_cell_hazard(entry), sides recounted. If no party-side entries remain: no enemies -> result 0; else chaos_sword_passout (!= -1 -> keep looping) or refresh + 'BATTLE IS LOST!' (unless g_no_more_enemies) with result 1; the loop ends. If enemies are gone while the party remains: 'VICTORY!' once (g_no_more_enemies = 1, play_triple_sweep_sound, flush). On exit flush_keyboard, g_beam_frame = 0xff, return result (0 = map cleared normally, 1 = lost).

0x58a0.name: g_combat_exit
0x58a0.meaning: exit direction chosen by the first leaver

0x5882.name: g_turn_tick
0x5882.meaning: save 0x2DC: combat turn tick 0..9, every 10th pass_time(1)

0x594f.name: g_door_tile
0x594f.meaning: timed door state, cleared every combat turn

name: find_nearest_enemy
purpose: Target selection for roster entry ri; sets g_dx/g_dy to the unit step towards the chosen target (reversed when ri is fleeing, flag 2) and returns the target index (-1 none or self). Own side = combatant_side(ri); under status icon 'C' a get_combat_stat(-1, ri) value below random_damage_1_30 makes it treat the party side (0) as its own. Scans entries 31..0 other than ri with non-zero flags, not 0x20, on the opposite side, not swallowed (4) and - unless g_location_backup == 0x28 or ri is type '/' (0x2f) - without flag 0x10; entries with index < 5 bump a party counter; the smallest COMSUBS e66a(ty, tx, y, x) distance wins. If no party entry and no target were seen the target comes from chaos_sword_passout; still none -> every monster entry 6..31 (flag 0x40) gets HP 1 and the flee flag and the target cell becomes (5,5). Target cell coordinates are uninitialised when chaos_sword_passout supplied the target (Rust uses 0).

name: monster_move
purpose: Moves roster entry ri; returns 1 when it moved, 0 otherwise. Types 0x1b and 0x1a never move. A monster of a type with flag 0x2000 (teleporter), unless the status icon is 'N' or 0x1c, teleports when surrounded (is_combatant_surrounded) or on a 3/4 roll: random_combat_cell gives g_dx/g_dy, combat_cell_free must accept it, roster and monster-table x/y are set and '<name> teleports!' printed. Otherwise, if not surrounded: find_nearest_enemy sets the step; on rand(0..255) < 0x80 or when the horizontal cell is blocked (is_cell_blocked_for) the vertical step is tried (g_dx = 0, code 0x3e6 if free), else the horizontal one (g_dy = 0, code 999); if no code was set up to 4 random directions (0 S, 1 E, 2 N, 3 W) are rolled until a free cell (code 0x3df). Non-zero code moves the entry by (g_dx,g_dy) in both the roster and the monster table and sets g_combat_state_flags = 0x10 when the new position is outside the map (combat_pos_in_bounds == 0). Quirk: after an exhausted random walk the code may be 1..3 with a zero step, counting as a move.

name: check_room_trigger
purpose: Dungeon-room trigger check at combat cell (x,y) (Ghidra: param_1=y, param_2=x); only active when g_combat_flags has 0x80 or 2. The room record loaded into the combat-map buffer carries 8 triggers: trigger x at 0xae1f[8], trigger y at 0xae27[8], replacement tile at 0xad1f[8], first target x/y at 0xae3f/0xae47, second target x/y at 0xae5f/0xae67. Every trigger at (x,y) is consumed (positions set to 0xff) and each target cell inside 0..10 gets the replacement tile in g_light_map. Returns 1 after refresh_map_view when any trigger fired, else 0. Called by SJOG move_combatant and CMDS.

0xad1f.name: g_room_trigger_tile
0xad1f.meaning: tile placed when the trigger fires

notes: catalog lists no callers because the callers use vector 1778:073a

name: random_combat_cell
purpose: g_dx = rand(0..15), g_dy = rand(0..15); returns 1 when both are < 11 (inside the combat map) else 0. Used by monster_move teleports and the CAST/CAST2 spells.

name: remove_combatant
purpose: Removes a combatant (vector 1778:0602). arg < 0: roster entry (-1 - arg): its monster-table slot is read from +4 and all entry bytes (+4,+1,+0,+7,+6,+5,+2) are zeroed. arg >= 0: monster-table slot arg - 1 directly. Then the slot's x, anim tile, tile, value1, z and y are zeroed. Called by SJOG leave_combat, CMDS escape, CAST, COMSUBS and the COMBAT death paths.

name: roll_attack_damage
purpose: Damage roll (Ghidra: param_1=defender, param_2=attacker). Party-side attacker (flag 0x40 clear) uses g_attack_weapon: 0x27 glass sword -> 'Thy sword hath shattered!', remove_equipped_item(0x27, attacker) and damage 99 (instant kill); 0x28 -> 0; 0xff -> 1; else g_item_attack[weapon], rolled rand(1..value) when value > 1 and != 99. Monster attacker: g_monster_stats[type]+3 (0x13c0). Damage 99 is returned as is; otherwise the defender's armour (party record +0x18 at 0x55c0, monster g_monster_stats+2 at 0x13bf), if non-zero, subtracts rand(1..armour); the result may be negative (absorbed).
notes: string 0x6f1a; remove_equipped_item receives the roster index as 'member' (faithful)

name: combatant_dexterity
purpose: Returns 1 (defenceless) when the status icon is 'T' and the entry is a monster (flag 0x40), when the entry is type 0x1a, or when it is asleep (flag 8); otherwise the entry's initiative byte (+1, dexterity for party members).

name: get_combat_stat
purpose: Stat lookup for the hit roll (Ghidra: param_1=kind, param_2=roster_index). kind >= 1 is a weapon id (party entries): items with class byte 8 at 0x169c[item] select -3 (strength), others -2 (dexterity). Monster entries keep kind != 0; kind 0 selects -3 when the low byte of g_monster_flags has 0x80 else -2. Then -4: party compute_member_defense(member), monster 0x13bf (stats+2); -3: party record +0x0c (0x55b4, strength), monster 0x13bc (byte before the type's stats record); -2: combatant_dexterity; -1: party record +0x0e (0x55b6, intelligence), monster 0x13be (stats+1); other kinds return an uninitialised local (0 in Rust).

name: attack_hits
proto: int attack_hits(int defender, int attacker, int neg_spell_mode, int weapon)
purpose: Hit roll (Ghidra: param_1=weapon, param_2=unused -g_spell_mode, param_3=attacker, param_4=defender). Automatic hit for weapons 0x27/0x23/0x28 outside spell mode and for spells 0x2a..0x31 or 0x33 in spell mode (g_spell_mode != 0). Else defender stat = get_combat_stat(-2, defender) (dexterity; -1 in spell mode), attacker stat = get_combat_stat(weapon, attacker) (-1 in spell mode); hit when random_damage_1_30() >= (defender - attacker + 30) / 2. Returns 1 hit / 0 miss. Also used by COMSUBS ec48/edd8.

name: apply_damage
purpose: Applies amount damage to roster entry ri (Ghidra: param_1=amount, param_2=ri); returns the experience value of a killed monster ((g_monster_stats+4 >> 2) + 1) else 0. amount < 1 sets g_combat_state_flags = 0x20 and becomes 0. Monster entry: undead types (flag 0x20) take half unless g_attack_is_spell, flag 8 types take none; HP (+0) floors at 0. Death (HP 0 or amount 99): flags = 0x20, HP 0; types without flags 0x1001: type 0x1c leaves object tile 0x1f and add_combatant(z,y,x,0,0x1f) spawns a new creature, refresh, return; type 0x1e sets the map cell (get_map_tile) to 0x4c; else on a combat-map tile > 3 and != 0x87 it drops a corpse (0x1f) when stats+6 (0x13c3) < random_damage_1_30, otherwise a chest (tile 1, value1 = stats+6, bit 7 trapped when a second roll is below it) and returns without freeing the slot; otherwise remove_combatant(-1 - ri). Types with 0x1001: flag 0x1000 prints '<name> vanishes!', g_combat_state_flags = 2, object tile 0x16, tile_transition_effect(y,x,map tile), remove_combatant(-(ri+1)), chaos_sword_passout, return; else remove_combatant(-(ri+1)). A surviving dividing type (flag 0x10) tries 8 times: COMSUBS e9b4(y,x) picks g_dx/g_dy, combat_cell_free, add_combatant(z, g_dy, g_dx, 0, (tile-0x40)>>2) copies the HP, '<name> divides!', returns 0. Party entry: HP (record +0x10) -= amount; at <= 0 or amount 99: HP 0, flag 0x20, status 'D', object tile 0x1e, g_active_member cleared if it was this member; draw_status_window.

name: poison_attack
purpose: Poison attack (vector 1778:076a; Ghidra: param_1=attacker, param_2=target). A party-member target with status 'G' becomes 'P': '<name> is poisoned!', g_combat_state_flags = 8, status dirty. Any other target takes rand(0..20) via apply_damage; when attacker >= 0 is a party member the kill value is added to its experience (record +0x14 at 0x55bc, cap 9999 = the 0x270f 'string' argument).

name: deal_attack_damage
purpose: Resolves a landed hit (Ghidra: param_1=attacker, param_2=target). A monster attacker of a type with flags 0x204 poisons (poison_attack) when rand(0..3) != 0; the poison spell (weapon 0x33) in spell mode also poisons. Monster type 0x1c puts an awake target to sleep (incapacitate_combatant); the sleep spell (0x34) in spell mode too. Otherwise roll_attack_damage(target, attacker): a negative result against a party member sets g_combat_state_flags = 0x20 (absorbed) and returns; else apply_damage and, for a party attacker, the kill value is added to experience (cap 9999). Also called by COMSUBS ec48/edd8.

name: monster_morale
purpose: Morale class for a monster entry; sets (bit 1) or clears the flee flag. Party entries return their roster entry offset unchanged. q = g_monster_stats[type]+4 >> 2: HP < q -> 1 and flee; HP >= 2q -> 3 (HP < 3q) or 4, no flee; q <= HP < 2q -> 2, flee only when rand(0..256) >= 0xfc. Ghidra shows the small return values as DAT_1f64_0001.. pointers.

name: apply_cell_hazard
purpose: Hazard at the cell roster entry ri stands on, run after its turn. Combat-map tile 0x8f or 0xbc -> 100 (fire), tile 4 -> 50 (swamp); else the first other monster-table object on the cell: 0xea fire field 100, 0xe8 poison field 50, 0xe9 sleep field 150. 50: unless the entry's own object tile is >= 0x80, poison_attack(-1, ri) and flash. 100: flash, apply_damage(rand(0..10)), COMSUBS e4f2(0xff, ri), status dirty. 150: incapacitate_combatant(ri).

name: regurgitate_check
purpose: Escape roll for a swallowed entry (flag 4): when random_damage_1_30() < its initiative byte, '<name> regurgitated!' (party name from the record at 0x55a8, monster name from g_creature_name_ptrs) with play_random_tones(600,7000,1); flag 4 cleared and the object's anim tile (+1) restored from its tile (+0).
